items.name: Coil array
items.description: d20 13. Link multiple coil spring drives to increase Max Speed (up to +3).

items.name: Coil spring crank
items.description: d20 14. Crank to increase Max Speed by 1.

items.name: Residuum drive
items.description: d20 15. Expend spell slots to increase Max Speed.

items.name: Enervation drive
items.description: d20 17. Damage all occupants to gain temp hp and +2 Max Speed.

items.name: Elemental drive
items.description: d20 18. +2 Max Speed; releases a fire elemental if destroyed.

items.name: Phlogiston booster
items.description: d20 19. Engage to increase current Speed by 3.

items.name: Blink capacitor
items.description: d20 20. While charged, teleport the junk one position.

monsters.name: Blitzwing
monsters.notes: Adult blue dragon. FIRST Blitzwing revealed: he passes high overhead, no fight, press Victory. SECOND Blitzwing: he strafes the party with Lightning Breath (DC 19 Dex, 12d10 lightning, half on a save), then returns to D. Blitzwing's Scrapyard; press Victory once resolved.

monsters.name: Ghouls
monsters.notes: A gang of 1d4 + 2 ghouls dressed as junk racers descend on the party.

monsters.name: Black Pudding
monsters.notes: A random character accidentally steps into what looks like a puddle of oil, but it is actually a black pudding.
